description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for user authentication, including registration, login, and retrieval of current user profile. It interacts with User and Activity models, uses middleware for authentication, and manages JWT tokens.

methods.name: POST /auth/register
methods.description: Handles user registration by creating a new user, hashing the password, recording activity, and returning a JWT token.

methods.name: POST /auth/login
methods.description: Authenticates a user, records login activity, and returns a JWT token.

methods.name: GET /auth/me
methods.description: Retrieves current authenticated user's profile information based on the provided token.
